539: data StructUnpackState = StructUnpackState {
540:   -- | stNeedsPad is whether or not a type_pad() is needed. As near
541:   -- as I can tell the conditions are:
542:   --    1. a list was unpacked
543:   --    2. a struct was unpacked
544:   -- ListFontsWithInfoReply is an example of a struct which has lots of
545:   -- this type of thing.
546:   stNeedsPad :: Bool,
547: 
548:   -- The list of names the struct.pack accumulator has, and the
549:   stNames :: [String],
550: 
551:   -- The list of pack directives (potentially with a "%c" in it for
552:   -- the prefix byte).
553:   stPacks :: String
554: }
555: 
556: -- | Make a struct style (i.e. not union style) unpack.
557: mkStructStyleUnpack :: String
558:                     -> String
559:                     -> TypeInfoMap
560:                     -> [GenStructElem Type]
561:                     -> (Suite, Maybe Int)
562: mkStructStyleUnpack prefix ext m membs =
563:   let unpacked = map (structElemToPyUnpack (mkName "unpacker") ext m) membs
564:       initial = StructUnpackState False [] prefix
565:       (_, unpackStmts, size) = evalState (mkUnpackStmts unpacked) initial
566:       base = [mkAssign "base" $ mkName "unpacker.offset"]
567:       bufsize =
568:         let rhs = BinaryOp Minus (mkName "unpacker.offset") (mkName "base")
569:         in [mkAssign (mkAttr "bufsize") rhs]
570:       statements = base ++ unpackStmts ++ bufsize
571:   in (statements, size)
572: 
573:     where
574:       -- Apparently you only type_pad before unpacking Structs or Lists, never
575:       -- base types.
576:       mkUnpackStmts :: [Either (Maybe String, String)
577:                                (String, Either (Expr, Expr)
578:                                                ([(Expr, [GenStructElem Type])]), Maybe Int)]
579:                     -> State StructUnpackState ([String], Suite, Maybe Int)
580: 
581:       mkUnpackStmts [] = flushAcc
582: 
583:       mkUnpackStmts (Left (name, pack) : xs) = do
584:         st <- get
585:         let packs = if "%c" `isInfixOf` (stPacks st)
586:                     then addStructData (stPacks st) pack
587:                     else (stPacks st) ++ pack
588:         put $ st { stNames = stNames st ++ maybeToList name
589:                  , stPacks = packs
590:                  }
591:         mkUnpackStmts xs
592: 
593:       mkUnpackStmts (Right (thisName, listOrSwitch, thisSz) : xs) = do
594:         (packNames, packStmt, packSz) <- flushAcc
595:         st <- get
596:         put $ st { stNeedsPad = True }
597:         let thisStmts = mkUnpackListOrSwitch thisName listOrSwitch (stNeedsPad st) st
598:         (restNames, restStmts, restSz) <- mkUnpackStmts xs
599:         let totalSize = do
600:                           before <- packSz
601:                           rest <- restSz
602:                           thisSz' <- thisSz
603:                           return $ before + rest + thisSz'
604:         return ( packNames ++ [thisName] ++ restNames
605:                , packStmt ++ thisStmts ++ restStmts
606:                , totalSize
607:                )
608:           where
609:             mkUnpackListOrSwitch :: String
610:                                  -> Either (Expr, Expr)
611:                                            ([(Expr, [GenStructElem Type])])
612:                                  -> Bool
613:                                  -> StructUnpackState
614:                                  -> Suite
615:             mkUnpackListOrSwitch name' (Left (list, cons)) needsPad _ =
616:               let pad = if needsPad
617:                         then [typePad cons]
618:                         else []
619:               in pad ++ [mkAssign (mkAttr name') list]
620:             mkUnpackListOrSwitch _ (Right switchList) _ st' =
621:               let (conds, elems) = unzip switchList
622:                   stmts = map (mkUnpackSwitchElems st') elems
623:               in map (\(cond,body) -> Conditional cond body []) $ zip conds stmts
624: 
625:             mkUnpackSwitchElems :: StructUnpackState
626:                                 -> [GenStructElem Type]
627:                                 -> Suite
628:             mkUnpackSwitchElems st' elems' =
629:               let unpacked' = map (structElemToPyUnpack (mkName "unpacker") ext m) elems'
630:                   (_, stmts', _) = evalState (mkUnpackStmts unpacked') st'
631:               in stmts'
632: 
633:       flushAcc :: State StructUnpackState ([String], Suite, Maybe Int)
634:       flushAcc = do
635:         StructUnpackState needsPad args keys <- get
636:         let size = calcsize keys
637:             assign = mkUnpackFrom "unpacker" args keys
638:         put $ StructUnpackState needsPad [] ""
639:         return (args, assign, Just size)
640: 
641:       typePad e = StmtExpr (mkCall "unpacker.pad" [e])

646: mkModify ext name ti m =

652: mkSyntheticMethod :: [GenStructElem Type] -> [Statement]
653: mkSyntheticMethod membs = do
654:   let names = catMaybes $ map getName membs
655:       args = "cls" : names
656:       self = mkAssign "self" $ mkCall (mkDot "cls" "__new__") [mkName "cls"]
657:       body = map assign names
658:       ret = mkReturn $ mkName "self"
659:       synthetic = Decorated "classmethod" "synthetic" args $ (self : body) ++ [ret]
660:   if null names then [] else [synthetic]
661:     where
662:       getName :: GenStructElem Type -> Maybe String
663:       getName (Pad _ _) = Nothing
664:       getName (X.List n _ _ _) = Just n
665:       getName (SField n _ _ _) = Just n
666:       getName (ExprField n _ _) = Just n
667:       getName (ValueParam _ n _ _) = Just n
668:       getName (Switch n _ _ _) = Just n
669:       getName (Doc _ _ _) = Nothing
670:       getName (Fd n) = Just n
671:       getName (Length _ _) = Nothing
672: 
673:       assign :: String -> Statement
674:       assign n = mkAssign (mkDot "self" n) $ mkName n

715:   m <- get

726: processXDecl ext (XRequest name opcode _ membs reply) = do
727:   m <- get
728:   let
729:       -- xtest doesn't seem to use the same packing strategy as everyone else,
730:       -- but there is no clear indication in the XML as to why that is. yay.
731:       prefix = if ext /= "xproto" then "xx2x" else "x%c2x"
732:       (args, packStmts) = mkPackStmts ext name m id prefix membs
733:       cookieName = (name ++ "Cookie")
734:       replyDecl = concat $ maybeToList $ do
735:         GenXReply _ reply' <- reply
736:         let (replyStmts, _) = mkStructStyleUnpack "x%c2x4x" ext m reply'
737:             replyName = name ++ "Reply"
738:             theReply = mkXClass replyName "xcffib.Reply" False replyStmts []
739:             replyType = mkAssign "reply_type" $ mkName replyName
740:             cookie = mkClass cookieName "xcffib.Cookie" [replyType]
741:         return [theReply, cookie]
742: 
743:       hasReply = if length replyDecl > 0
744:                  then [mkName cookieName]
745:                  else []
746:       -- another hack for not supporting named parameters
747:       -- argChecked = ArgKeyword (ident "is_checked") (mkName "is_checked")
748:       argChecked = mkName ("is_checked=is_checked")
749:       -- a hack to not have to support separate params/exprs
750:       -- checkedParam = Param (ident "is_checked") Nothing (Just isChecked)
751:       checkedParam = "is_checked=" ++ (show (isJust reply))
752:       allArgs = ("self" : (filter (not . null) args)) ++ [checkedParam]
753:       ret = mkReturn $ mkCall "self.send_request" ([ Int opcode
754:                                                    , mkName "buf"
755:                                                    ]
756:                                                    ++ hasReply
757:                                                    ++ [argChecked])
758:       requestBody = buf ++ packStmts ++ [ret]
759:       request = mkMethod name allArgs requestBody
760:       baseArgs = ("self" : (filter (not . null) args))
761:       checkedMethod = mkMethod (name ++ "Checked") baseArgs
762:         [mkReturn $ mkCall ("self." ++ name) (map mkName (tail baseArgs) ++ [mkName "is_checked=True"])]
763:       uncheckedMethod = mkMethod (name ++ "Unchecked") baseArgs
764:         [mkReturn $ mkCall ("self." ++ name) (map mkName (tail baseArgs) ++ [mkName "is_checked=False"])]
765: 
766:   return [Request request replyDecl, Request checkedMethod [], Request uncheckedMethod []]
767: processXDecl ext (XUnion name _ membs) = do
768:   m <- get
769:   let unpackF = structElemToPyUnpack unpackerCopy ext m
770:       (_, stmts) = span EC.isLeft $ map unpackF membs
771:       -- not exactly correct, same problem as in commit
772:       -- 64168007c20e80dd58e2456d8dac74e71d7f6b96 or
773:       -- d2d521fd117f2d2698f8d4ef1fd4792a4ef1c088, i.e. we shouldn't partition
774:       -- these, we should render them in order. (hilariously, those commits
775:       -- mention partitionEithers, which is equivalent to (span EC.isLeft)...

777:       -- Here, we only want to pack the first member of the union, since every
778:       -- member is the same data and we don't want to repeatedly pack it.
779:       pack = mkPackMethod ext name m Nothing [head membs] Nothing
780:       decl = [mkXClass name "xcffib.Union" False initMethodStmts [pack]]
